title: Forced Harem
paragraphs: “What is Amaki-dono so angry about?”
Éclair tilted her head with a puzzled look.
“Um, Éclair-chan, you see, Ren-chan is—”
“Shut up, don’t explain. I get it, go cling to Naofumi!”
Ren snapped at the older sister in a quick, sharp tone.
Does he dislike this topic that much?
“Damn it! I really want to meet this Naofumi from the first world!”
“What kind of parting shot is that?”
“Hmm… I don’t quite get it, but am I allowed to be angry now?”
“Now, now.”
Father calmed Éclair down.
“Anyway, I get it. So spring has finally come for Naofumi-san. Congratulations.”

Itsuki and Ren clapped listlessly. I joined in and clapped as well. At this rate, Father will marry the older sister. In the first world, it seemed like he was about to develop an impure relationship with Filo-tan, so seeing him end up with the older sister feels like a huge relief.
“Yeah… thanks. I’m happy to be congratulated.”
Father smiled, holding hands with the older sister.
“I’ll definitely make Sadina-san happy. I’ll also find that girl named Raphtalia for sure. I’ll become a parent figure to everyone.”
“How wonderful.”
The older sister responded with a dreamy look. Then, she pulled out a bottle of wine from who knows where and started drinking.
“But Naofumi-chan, you can’t love just me, okay?”
“Huh?”
Father, along with Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair, tilted their heads at her words.
“What is Sadina-dono talking about?”
Éclair was the first to speak. But since Ren and Itsuki also didn’t seem to understand the situation, they remained silent.
“Uh, no, I’m devoted to Sadina-san—”
Before Father could finish, the older sister gently placed her hand on his cheek. This feels no different from how the older sister was in the first world.
“Naofumi-chan is the Shield Hero who will save the world, right? That means he’s someone who can bring happiness to and love many people.”
“Eh? Eh? Eh?”
Father had a bewildered expression.
“A woman who wishes for her lover to have a harem? How unusual.”
Itsuki looked astonished.
“Oh no~. There’s no way Naofumi-chan can only make me happy. Besides, it looks like Naofumi-chan isn’t into younger girls.”
The older sister took Father’s hand and walked toward the panda. Then, she took the panda’s arm and stood up.
“Hm? What’s this?”
“Sa-Sasa-chan. Let’s indulge in a night of passion.”
“Huh?”
“Eh? Sadina-san!?”
“I know, you know? Sasa-chan also harbors a faint crush on Naofumi-chan.”
“W-What are you talking about? I—”
“Come on! The night is still young. Naofumi-chan, Sasa-chan, let’s enjoy ourselves to the fullest.”
“Huh? Wait, hold on!”
And just like that, Father and the panda were dragged away by the older sister.
What should I do now? Should I stop them even at this point? Father looked confused, but he wasn’t exactly resisting.
Is he about to do something naughty with the older sister? It’s a scene I vaguely remember from my days of chasing after pigs. But since it’s the older sister, I doubt it will lead to anything bad.
“Yeah… I definitely don’t want that kind of relationship.”
Ren’s words left quite an impression.
“Agreed. Naofumi-san really fell for quite the person.”
“That’s what happens when you’re blinded by love!”
“…Aren’t you using that phrase incorrectly?”
“Well, maybe… Before I broke, I probably would’ve thought she was just a convenient woman.”
“The older sister? She’s not my type.”

Thinking back to when I was chasing after pigs, I probably would’ve gone for it if I had the chance. But I don’t think I could handle being with the older sister. She’s just way too strong when it comes to alcohol.
“The older sister’s ideal type is someone who can hold their liquor, I say.”
“I’ve heard that before. There was someone in Father’s domain who could drink like a monster, and they always said their future husband would have to outdrink them. So that was Sadina-dono…”
“Then Naofumi-san is the perfect match. He doesn’t get drunk after all.”
“They ended up together because it was meant to be. Naofumi sure has bad luck with women.”
Is that so? Looking at the older sister, Filo-tan, and the many others, I don’t think that’s entirely true.
“True, he was tricked by that ghost princess and is being targeted by Gaelion-san.”

“That aside, Sadina-dono and Iwatani-dono get along so naturally, and thinking about life after the world is at peace, I think Sadina-dono is a good match… Though her sexual preferences are a bit of an issue.”
“Speaking of which, didn’t we just casually abandon Naofumi-san? Is that really okay?”
“If he was really against it, Naofumi would’ve escaped. Even that panda… Larsa Zusa.”
After thinking for a moment, Itsuki nodded at Ren’s analysis.
“…That’s true. Naofumi-san is the most stubborn among the heroes, so if he really didn’t want it, there’s no way Sadina-san could have dragged him along.”
“So, are they going to do it after this?”
“Amaki-dono.”
Éclair warned him.
“They say even heroes are not immune to lust. All I can do is bless Iwatani-dono for finally finding a woman he likes.”
“By that logic, that means we’re all lustful too…”
“True… Ever since we were summoned to this world, we’ve had too many shocking experiences, and romance wasn’t really on the table.”
“Bwe!?”
“Don’t worry, Rishia-san. I have no such intentions.”
“…That’s true. Naofumi was also distrustful of women after being targeted by the pig king and being pursued with lustful eyes.”
“Especially since Naofumi-san was deceived by that ghost princess.”
“I hope Amaki-dono finds someone too. I pray that, like Iwatani-dono, Kawasumi-dono, and Kitamura-dono, you’ll also find your destined partner without falling to any schemes.”
I have a feeling that Ren from the first world is crying somewhere, but that’s probably just my imagination. At that moment, Itsuki clapped his hands as if he had realized something.
“I see, so Gaelion fainted because he sensed this?”
“Ah, that explains it. He probably picked up on some scent or something after Naofumi and Sadina…”
“Gaelion-san had been making passionate advances toward Naofumi-san. He must have been shocked to know Sadina-san took him.”
“But if Sadina’s the opponent, Gaelion might still have a chance.”
“Indeed. Let’s keep an eye on how this develops.”
“A rival and Father in a romantic relationship? I won’t allow it!”
“Ah… Motoyasu-san, it’s Naofumi-san’s choice. If you interfere, he might not approve of your engagement with Filo-san.”
Ugh… Itsuki mentioned the worst possible outcome. But I can’t stand it.
If a rival dares to get romantically involved with Father, should I just eliminate them without being noticed? I’ll think about it.
“Well then, it’s about time we disperse and get some rest for tomorrow.”
“Yeah.”
And so, after cooling down from the bath, we all retired to our rooms for the night. The next morning.
“What a wonderful morning.”

It’s a refreshing awakening. I gazed at the morning sun from the window. Today is the day we head to the Nosferatu Great Forest. I can only pray that among the collected filolial eggs, Filo-tan will hatch.
“Well then, on such a fine morning, perhaps I’ll go for a little walk.”
“Su…”

I quietly left the room so as not to wake Yuki-chan and Kou. This is surprisingly difficult. Everyone here has extremely sharp senses. As the Love Hunter, it’s only natural for me to move in a way that doesn’t disturb the peacefully sleeping filolial-sama. As I was walking down the hallway for my morning stroll, I noticed at the inn’s entrance… the place where I once angered the older sister and where she had waited for Father. Father and the panda were sitting there, completely drained and pale.
